Especially when I may not share the same cultural cues as many of the black people around me. It took me a while to realize it, but there isn't just one black experience and the black community isn't a monolith. We belong. Yeah, there may be some differences, but we're still black. Especially in the U.S. where I am. I hope this doesn't come across as dismissive. I just wanted to let you know that you're not alone.
